systems.platform: bespoke web and mobile application by MK WBC
systems.owner: UNICEF Cameroon (commissioned by tender); Ministry of Public Health departments took part in the training
systems.tiers: four integrated health centres (CSI) in four pilot health districts of the South Region: Ebolowa, Meyomessala, Sangmelima, Ambam; use to begin after training of 6-11 October 2025

note: The software follows pregnant and breastfeeding women and adolescents living with HIV (medication and appointment tracking), so it is a single-programme tracker and gives no hmis or emr fact.
